item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence that Biden put family members, business partners, or ideological loyalists in charge of core economic policy. The clearest counterevidence is indirect: general reports of loyalty and insularity around Biden’s broader inner circle. On the economic side, the evidence is dominated by credentialed officials and technocratic policy language, which weighs positive for this lens.","evidence":[{"title":"Brown economist, education scholar appointed to White House Council of Economic Advisers","publisher":"Brown University","date":"2024-07-24","url":"https://www.brown.edu/news/2024-07-24/matthew-kraft","summary":"The Biden administration appointed Matthew Kraft, an academic economist, to the CEA to provide real-time objective evidence and analysis for policy.
